history.summary: A 408-unit Amber Road leasehold (103yr from 2009) in the desirable D15 Katong/Marine Parade lifestyle belt with the new Amber/Marine Parade TEL stations on its doorstep. But at $2.03M and $2,219 psf the 2BR is pushing the top of the project's own transaction range (12mo high ~$2,244), so the easy TEL re-rating already looks priced in.
history.rating_rationale: 915sqft 2BR at $2.03M / $2,219 psf sits just above the URA median ($2,194) and near the 12-month transaction ceiling — little headroom. The $2M+ price band thins the 2BR buyer pool, and lease is only 103yr from 2009 (~86yr left, decaying). D15 lifestyle appeal, TEL access and 408-unit liquidity are genuine strengths, but with the TEL catalyst largely realized and an asking at the top of range, risk/reward is balanced. MMR 1520 / score 600 — the weakest technical in the batch. 5.3% CAGR over 94 txns is solid but not exceptional.
red_flags: Asking psf near top of project's own 12-month range — TEL uplift already priced in
$2.03M pushes into the thinner >$2M 2BR buyer band
catalysts: Amber TE25 / Marine Parade TE26 TEL stations now operational nearby
D15 East Coast lifestyle district with deep owner-occupier appeal
